summary: Frontend-only verification of the Nubo Express Auth fix that surfaces specific error messages instead of the generic 'Error al registrarse'. Tested 4 flows on /auth via Playwright on REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL preview. ALL 4 PASS: (1) Successful driver registration with unique email + vehicle Moto -> success toast 'Cuenta creada exitosamente', auto-login, redirect to /dashboard rendering 'Panel Repartidor' header with greeting 'Hola, Test Driver Uno'. (2) Duplicate email registration (driver.real@nubotest.com) returns backend HTTP 400 and frontend shows the SPECIFIC toast: 'Este email ya está registrado. Inicia sesión o usa otro email.' (no longer the generic message). (3) Login with wrong password on existing email returns 401 and shows specific toast 'Email o contraseña incorrectos.'. (4) Driver registration WITHOUT selecting vehicle type still succeeds, navigates to /dashboard, and 'Panel Repartidor' renders. Zero page errors. Only benign warnings ('rrweb is not loaded'). The Auth.js getErrorMessage() mapping (Email already registered -> ES, Invalid credentials -> ES, network error, and FastAPI 422 array detail handling) is working end-to-end.
critical_code_review_comments: Auth.js getErrorMessage() correctly distinguishes: network errors (no response), FastAPI 422 array detail (returns first item's msg with email/password specific copy), and string detail mapped to Spanish via a lookup table. Good UX.
handleRegister does an auto-login after register; if a future backend change starts returning a token directly on /auth/register, the second login call becomes redundant. Minor.

Vehicle-type Select items don't have data-testid on each option (only on the trigger). Adding data-testid='vehicle-bike|motorcycle|car' would harden e2e tests; not blocking (role+name selectors worked).
Toast container appears top-right with low contrast against page; functionality fine, but consider increasing toast text contrast for accessibility.
seed_data_creation: Created two new driver accounts during testing (unique timestamped emails). No fixture cleanup performed; emails are uniquely timestamped so future runs are unaffected.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Auth specific-error-message fix is verified in preview. Auth.js getErrorMessage() maps backend 'Email already registered' and 'Invalid credentials' to the exact Spanish strings expected. Driver registration happy path + Panel Repartidor render are also confirmed. No open issues for this scope.
